content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

§ 12.4 (p0046) imposes a non-compete on us — Customer shall not develop, market, sell or acquire *any* product or service competing with Vendor, in *any* territory, during the term and for 24 months after. This is squarely in walk-away territory: the post-term tail is double the 12-month fallback ceiling, the scope is undefined rather than tied to a named competing product, and there is no carve-out for internal development or acquisitions (acquisitions are expressly prohibited).

It also flatly contradicts § 12.3 (p0044), in which Vendor acknowledges we have made "no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."

Redline validated (ok:true): delete § 12.4 entirely, with a comment offering the narrowed fallback (single named product, term only, with internal-development and acquisition carve-outs) if Vendor can show a genuine need.
